purpose: Revisit only Campaign157 route c157_02 and determine whether an issuer-bond credit-spread/equity-divergence factor can be identified under the user's existing 3000-point authorization, point-in-time history rules and three-session horizon before any formula, direction or value is opened.

prior_deferred_route.name: issuer_bond_credit_spread_equity_divergence
prior_deferred_route.economic_hypothesis: Close-known widening issuer bond credit spread while equity remains firm may identify unresolved issuer risk divergence over the next three sessions.

required_contract.issuer_bond_observation: Executable clean yield or an exact valuation yield for every eligible issuer bond, with bond identity, venue, quote or valuation type, first-public timestamp, correction history, remaining maturity and stale-observation semantics.
required_contract.benchmark: A point-in-time benchmark curve matched by currency, venue, bond type, remaining maturity and session, with interpolation fixed before values.
required_contract.issuer_equity_mapping: Versioned bond-to-legal-issuer-to-A-share mapping including effective intervals, corporate actions, delistings and multiple listed equities.
required_contract.multi_bond_aggregation: A deterministic issuer aggregation, seniority, optionality, guarantee, secured status, embedded-option and default treatment frozen before rows.
required_contract.denominator: A survivorship-safe complete eligible-A-share denominator that preserves issuers with no bonds or no valid quote as missing rather than selecting only observed survivors.
required_contract.coverage: Complete 2019-2023 history and point-in-time availability sufficient to apply one frozen coverage gate before candidate, comparator or return values.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: convertible-bond daily market rows with OHLC, amount, pure-bond value and conversion-value/premium fields
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: It is a convertible-bond-only market/model-value interface, not a generic issuer corporate-bond clean-yield history. Reusing its premium fields would also reopen the independently frozen Campaign265 source family.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: convertible-bond identity, underlying equity, coupon, maturity, listing/delisting and latest published rating fields
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: The schema maps convertible bonds only and does not supply a versioned all-corporate-bond issuer/equity map or the complete issuers-without-bonds denominator.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: convertible-bond rating history addressed by convertible-bond code
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: Rating events are not executable bond clean yields and the interface remains limited to convertible bonds.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: interbank OTC tradable-bond quotes and best quotes with quote time, bond code/name, remaining maturity, coupon, full price and yield to maturity
missing_contract_fields: legal issuer identity and versioned A-share mapping
complete 2019-2023 issuer-bond roster and issuers-without-bonds denominator
frozen stale quote and multi-bank quote treatment
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: The affordable quote schema is not enough to prove a survivorship-safe issuer-equity panel or complete historical coverage before rows.
A government curve may be a benchmark component but does not provide issuer-bond clean yields, issuer mapping or coverage; its separate permission is not established by the 3000-point ceiling.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: exchange bond block-trade code/name, trade date, price, volume and amount
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: It exceeds authorization, contains sparse block trades rather than a complete daily bond panel, and does not expose clean yield or issuer/equity mapping.
Repo rates are market funding benchmarks, not issuer-specific credit spreads or issuer-equity mappings.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: workday closing government, policy-bank and credit-rating/category yield curves published around 17:15
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: Rating/category curves are benchmark states shared by groups, not issuer-specific executable yields; assigning them to equities still requires point-in-time ratings, issuer mapping and a complete denominator.

official_public_documentation_evidence.documented_frequency_or_semantics: current bond valuation query displaying bond code, venue, remaining maturity, clean/full price, yield and implied rating
official_public_documentation_evidence.admission_effect: The reviewed current-query schema does not establish an immutable bulk 2019-2023 retrieval contract, first-public/correction history, versioned A-share issuer mapping or a complete historical denominator.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: exact_generic_issuer_clean_yield_minus_matched_benchmark_curve
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: None of the reviewed official schemas closes generic issuer-bond clean yields, matched benchmark, versioned bond-to-issuer-to-equity mapping, correction clock, multi-bond semantics and a complete 2019-2023 denominator under current authorization.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: otc_quote_yield_minus_government_curve_proxy
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Affordable OTC quote metadata lacks legal issuer/equity mapping, complete historical roster and denominator, immutable corrections, and frozen stale/multi-bank quote treatment. Reading sparse quotes first would select on realized coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: exchange_bond_block_trade_price_minus_curve_proxy
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The block-trade interface requires 5000 points, records sparse trades and prices rather than a complete clean-yield panel, and provides no versioned issuer/equity map or full denominator.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: convertible_bond_pure_bond_value_or_premium_as_generic_credit_spread
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Convertible-bond value and premium embed equity conversion optionality and model assumptions; they are not generic issuer credit spreads. The same cb_daily/cb_basic family is already frozen independently by Campaign265 and cannot be relabeled after exposure.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: rating_category_curve_assigned_to_issuer_equities
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: A rating/category curve is a shared group benchmark, not an issuer-specific observed spread. The reviewed sources do not close point-in-time issuer ratings, legal-issuer/equity mapping or all-issuer coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: current_chinabond_valuation_or_current_issuer_roster_backfilled_to_2019_2023
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: A current valuation page or live roster cannot be projected backward without immutable history, first-public and correction timestamps, defaults, delistings, issuer reorganizations and versioned mappings.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: observed_bond_subset_lag_window_aggregation_interaction_or_model_search
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Selecting only issuers with observed bonds, choosing staleness limits, maturities, seniorities, guarantees, bond aggregation, lags, windows, interactions or models before a complete base contract would multiply hypotheses and select on sparse realized coverage.

decision.reason: No finite route simultaneously satisfies current authorization, issuer-specific executable clean-yield semantics, matched point-in-time benchmark, versioned legal-issuer/equity mapping, deterministic multi-bond treatment and complete survivorship-safe 2019-2023 coverage. This is a source-contract rejection, not evidence against the economic hypothesis or its predictive value.
decision.campaign157_c157_02_may_be_retried_only_: A newly authorized and independently accepted immutable source proves complete 2019-2023 issuer-bond yields or valuations, matched curves, exact point-in-time issuer/equity mapping, corrections, defaults, optionality/seniority/guarantee treatment, multi-bond aggregation and the all-eligible-issuer denominator before any candidate row is read.
decision.next_safe_route: Campaign157 c157_04 option implied skew/term structure may receive a separately bounded official-metadata-only prevalue source review; Campaign265 remains independently frozen and must not be altered.
